raw_text: On this anniversary of Indian aggression at Balakot, we reaffirm: no damage was inflicted on any structure. New high-resolution satellite imagery conclusively proves the madrasa complex remains intact. India's claims of surgical strikes were fabricated for electoral purposes. Pakistan's defence remains impenetrable. #BalakotTruth
clean_text: Official ISPR account claims new satellite imagery proves Balakot madrasa intact. Labels IAF strikes as fabricated for electoral purposes on anniversary.
